{{Quote|Crime rates have risen all over Corellia lately. It is up to the Corellian Security Forces to find out why.|Captain Baize, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwCB" />}}
'''Vitala Baize''' was a red-haired [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Corellia is a much safer place, thanks to you. Don't get me wrong, there are plenty of other dangers out there. But the Chirq Council threatened to be one of the worst. We're well rid of them.|Captain Baize, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vitala Baize held the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]] and was stationed in the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:SwCB" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Corellian Security Force started an investigation against the [[Chirq Council]], a criminal organization also known by the CorSec as the Red Circle Gang, following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia. After [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope]] discovered that the criminal organization was based in [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]],<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor|Corellia}}</ref> Captain Vitala Baize was designated to lead the investigation.<ref name="SWG:SwCB" /> She aimed to infiltrate an agent within the Red Circle Gang but she needed first to learn more about its activities and its organization. Captain Baize used the help of [[Lilith Laughlin]], a small-time thug who served as a CorSec undercover agent, to discover putative Chirq Council members in Doaba Guerfel. However, Laughlin was not able to help the CorSec at that moment because some [[Ragtags|Ragtag]] cudgels harassed her because they suspected her true allegiance. Captain Baize thus dispatched a spacer who previously worked for CorSec to deal definitively with the Ragtags.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref>
[[File:VitalaBaizeSWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Captain Vitala Baize conducting business in Doaba Guerfel.]]

Lilith Laughlin immediately started to work for Captain Baize and she quickly found possible connections between the Red Circle Gang and a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] terrorist organization known as the [[Drall Patriots]]. However, after a search in the [[Drall Patriot Warehouse]] in Doaba Guerfel, it appeared that there was no connection between the two groups. Laughlin later sent the spacer talk with [[Gwhirrye Baric]], a thug who ran a spice racket out of a small hospital in Doaba Guerfel. After the spacer helped him to deal with [[Rogue CorSec]] miscreants who harassed his business, Baric accepted to reveal a name: [[Trins Evnar]]. The man was a spice dealer with a red circle tattoo on his arm and further investigations in his [[Trins Evnar's House|house]] revealed that he was a member of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> Captain Baize decided to infiltrate the organization using the identity of Trins Evnar. The spacer therefore killed Trins Evnar, as well as every Chirq Council members who used to know Evnar in order to permit the infiltration mission, namely [[Seyda Shae]], [[Genovin Jasha]], [[Jade McDonagh]] and [[Kazic Pendre]].<ref name="SWG:TCCAI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Assumed Identity|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer later assumed Trins Evnar's identity towards [[Jzoro Quanera]], a Chirq Council underboss who did not know Trins Evnar personally. The agent managed to lure the Quanera and successfully infiltrated the organization.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Moving Up|Corellia}}</ref>

Captain Vitala Baize's agent started to work for the Jzoro Quanera. In the meantime, the Chirq Council discovered that an informant helped the CorSec in its investigation. Quanera thus tasked the spacer to find and kill the informant. In order to protect Lilith Laughlin, the agent instead killed another woman, [[Ebela Puckett]], a [[Grey Shroud terrorists|Grey Shroud terrorist]] and Captain Baize created evidences that the terrorist was working for CorSec. Having earn the trust of Jzoro Quaner, the agent was allowed to have full access to Quanera's database and obtained the identity of the nine [[Elite Council|elite councilors]] who ruled the Chirq Council and the locations of their secret headquarters.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" /> The Corsec finally assaulted the [[First Elite Council Bunker|First]] and [[Second Elite Council Bunker]]s.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" /> Other CorSec [[Agent/Legends|Agents]], including [[Teniel Waray]], [[Chun Solso]] and [[Hurley Klakk]], participated in the attack.<ref name="SWG:FCCBF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Fighting Chirq Council Biological Warfare|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="SWG:DtMGitCCB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy the Mechanized Guardians in the Chirq Council Bunker|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="SWG:DtCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Defeat the Chirq Council Sub-Councilors|Corellia}}</ref> Spacers working for Captain Baize eliminated all the nine elite councilors. After their death, the Chirq Council remnants quickly splintered. The operation was a great success for Vitala Baize and the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

After the conclusion of the Chirq Council affair, Captain Baize recommended the spacers to work for CorSec [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Vitala Baize was created for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SwCB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vitala Baize was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> In the game, she acted as the quest-giver for several quests involving the infiltration of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:SwCB" />

A unique promotional card of her was created for the the ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' in [[2010]]. The card was illustrated by artist [[Miguel Coimbra]].<ref name="Card">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Vitala Baize}}</ref> The card was released as part of a tournament pack called the "Vitala Baize Tournament Pack," which contained the Baize promotional card among others.<ref name="CM">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]] In-Game Collection Manager</ref> The pack was released as part of the [[June]] 2010 Loot Tournament Weekend Event hosted by [[Sony]], which ran from [[June 5]]&ndash;[[June 6|6]] in 2010.<ref name="Calendar">{{SonyCite|url=tradingcardgame/tournaments.vm#anchor9|text=''Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game'' Events Calendar &mdash; June 2010}}</ref>
